activity_summary: About two you were awake. You had been in bed by ten. The leaf was in the folder, unchanged, and you had not said it aloud. You counted three leaves and no name. You did not start another poem.

entities.name: the sonnet folder
entities.context: Mentioned in Awake, and not aloud

facets.activity: Woke about two and counted the three leaves

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: The leaf is in the folder. I did not change a word of it, and I did not say it aloud.
